reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment, which is the expected output when the document meets the preferred position; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so nothing was inadvertently changed.

The cited text supports compliance: § 14.16 (p0200) affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to enter similar agreements, and no exclusivity, field-of-use, territory or 'shall not compete' covenant binds Customer.

The only Customer-side 'shall not' identified (§ 14.11 no-resale of IBM's Services, p0190) is a scope-of-use limit on the Vendor's own Services rather than a restraint on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build, so it correctly falls outside NONCOMPETE; the no-reverse-engineering limit is likewise a licence-scope term.

Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, consistent with the compliant classification; the finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
